name: Tinker Repair Shot and Scrap Shot passives: Over-Repaired and Hasty Tech (#801, #1197)
contract: #801, #1197: both are native spell modifiers, so neither needs a script. Over-Repaired 807498 carries one ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) effect, EffectMiscValue 0 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, BasePoints 14 DieSides 1 (+15%), EffectSpellClassMask (32768,262144,0). Repair Shot 502573 has SpellFamilyName 34, SpellFamilyFlags (32768,2,0) (bit 15 intersects), effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL and AttributesEx3 0, so Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE to it. Hasty Tech 705805 carries one ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effect, EffectMiscValue 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints -16 DieSides 1 (-15%), mask (16,2,0): bit 4 is Scrap Shot 500549 (flags (16,0,256), CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms) and bit 33 is Repair Shot (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms). Scrap Shot sets SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT (Attributes 0x00010012) and is not an auto-repeat spell (AttributesEx2 0x00020000), so SpellInfo::CalcCastTime (SpellInfo.cpp:2946) adds 500 ms to its SpellCastTimes entry before any modifier is applied: its unmodified cast time is 3000 ms, not 2500 ms. Both spells then go through Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:12229), which applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME first and then scales by DmgClass: Scrap Shot is SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_RANGED and is scaled by m_modAttackSpeedPct[RANGED_ATTACK], Repair Shot is SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MAGIC and is scaled by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, both 1.0 on an unbuffed level-80 Tinker. So the cast times become 2550 ms and 1700 ms. Player::ApplySpellMod treats SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME as (base + flat) * mul, and SPELLMOD_DAMAGE percentages multiplicatively. Neither spell carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, and neither modifier appears in the family-34 routing switch in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, so both fall through to the ordinary class-mask test.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Repair Shot's healing is unmodified before the talents
Scrap Shot casts in 3000 ms before the talents
Repair Shot casts in 2000 ms before the talents
Over-Repaired raises Repair Shot's healing by 15%
The native healing calculation carries the same 15%
Over-Repaired does not reach Scrap Shot
Hasty Tech cuts Scrap Shot's cast time to 2550 ms
Hasty Tech cuts Repair Shot's cast time to 1700 ms
